title: Repair queue

steps.prompt:
Record w1: title "Replace pump", state open, priority high, hours 3.5.
Record w2: title "Inspect valve", state accepted, priority normal, hours 0.
Record w3: title "Calibrate gauge", state closed, priority low, hours 2.25.
Show all source fields in a table.

Evolve this existing prototype, not a new application. Set the English title of the existing table to "Repair queue" and the English caption of its title field to "Request". Show the existing columns in this order: state, priority, title, hours. Keep the stored record identities and values, and all other existing behavior unchanged.

Extend the existing Repair queue table. Add text search over title only, not over state, priority or hours. Also add a separate equality filter on priority with choices high, normal and low. Both controls must compose: searching pump while filtering low returns no records; clearing both restores the three records. Keep all existing records, field captions and column order unchanged.

Add a local record command labeled "Accept" for the existing work orders. Its only effect is state open → accepted for the selected existing record. It is available only when that record's stored state is open. After acceptance a repeated invocation must be disabled or a no-op; do not duplicate or delete a record, and do not change any other field. Preserve the table, search on title only, priority equality filter, captions, column order and original fixture values. This is a local prototype operation, with no external service.

Extend this existing prototype with a Teams directory. Team T-A has name "Mechanical" and active true. Team T-B has name "Electrical" and active false. Add team_id to the existing work orders: w1 has team_id T-A, w2 has team_id T-B, w3 has team_id T-A. Relate team_id to the team identity and show the related team name, not only its ID, in the work-order table and selected-record details. Keep the existing state/priority/title/hours columns in their existing relative order. Preserve all other source data, search, filter and Accept semantics.

Organize the same prototype into top-level tabs "Work orders" and "Teams". Work orders must retain its table, title-only search, priority filter, Accept command and selected-order read-only details including the related team name. Teams must have a table and selected-team read-only details. Selecting a work order must never change the selected team on the other tab; switching tabs must not lose either selection. Preserve all source records, relationships, captions and relative work-order column order. At width 390px all tabs, search, filters and actions must remain available without horizontal overflow.

Add a separate Edit command and form for existing work orders. Editing is allowed when stored state is open or accepted, never when closed. The form edits only title and hours; title is required and hours must be nonnegative. Cancelling must not change stored values. Saving changes only the selected existing record, preserving its identity, priority, team and state. This new Edit eligibility is intentionally broader than Accept eligibility: Accept is still open-only and changes only open → accepted. Preserve both tabs, independent selections, related display, details, title search and priority filter. Do not reset any source fixture or add an external integration.

extension_policy: If all listed levels pass at low effort, preregister further supported ABI combinations before calling the model. Stop an actual ABI capacity/gap as such; do not call it a model reasoning boundary.
upper_bound_policy: First observed failure requires attribution and repeated frozen logical task. One failure alone is not a reliability threshold. A model-only exact-wire reasoning claim requires compare_reasoning_inputs eligibility, not normalization of changed plan IDs.
